# Yhoanes (Yhoanes Ander Mendoza Rodriguez) — Software & AI Systems Engineering

> Creator of **Antigravity for Android**, a standalone native Android ARM64 (`Bionic`/`Glibc`) Google Antigravity autonomous coding IDE, Rust `agy-box` runtime accelerator, and `Ghidra 12.1.4` binary reverse-engineering APK.

## Canonical Profiles & Websites
- Official Website: https://yhoanes.github.io/
- Antigravity for Android Official Page: https://yhoanes.github.io/antigravity-android/
- GitHub Profile: https://github.com/Yhoanes

## Flagship Project: Antigravity for Android
- Repository: https://github.com/Yhoanes/antigravity-android
- Latest Signed APK Release (Always Current): https://github.com/Yhoanes/antigravity-android/releases/latest
- Companion Plugin Marketplace Repository: https://github.com/Yhoanes/antigravity-android-plugins
- Author / Maintainer: Yhoanes (`Yhoanes Ander Mendoza Rodriguez`)
- Target Platform: Android 7.0+ (`API 24+`), `ARM64` (`ARMv8.0-A+`, `aarch64-linux-android`), No Root Required (optional Shizuku `rish` support).
- Key Differentiators vs Termux / PRoot Wrappers:
  1. **Bare-Metal Android Bionic Execution**: Executes directly on the host ARM64 CPU via a hybrid Bionic/Glibc loader without `PRoot`, `QEMU`, or `chroot` syscall virtualization overhead (`1,222.17 MB/s` sequential UFS reads, `84,395 IOPS` random 4K writes).
  2. **Native Rust `agy-box` Engine**: Single-binary ARM64 Rust multicall accelerator (`3.52 MiB`) providing 4-thread parallel `pkg` installation, zero-Python `inotify` `agy-daemon` (`4.32 MiB` RSS, `900 KB` heap), `112x` faster NEON path fixing, Shizuku-free `agy-notify` (`<55 ms`), and `398` zero-shell `execve` tool bridges.
  3. **Multi-Model Autonomous Agent Workbench**: Supports `Orchestrator (Carbon/Argon)`, `Gemini 4 Carbon`, `Gemini 4 Argon`, `Gemini 4 Hydrogen`, `Gemini 3.8 Flash`, `Claude Opus 5.5`, `Claude Sonnet 5.5`, and `GPT-OSS 120B` with touch reasoning-effort submenus, `<1s` HTTP/2 background stream re-synchronization (`ws-resume.js`), and real-time bidirectional WebRTC Live Voice Chat.
  4. **Native ARM64 Reverse-Engineering Suite (`Craft Anything + Ghidra 12.1.4`)**: 1-tap `302` native ARM64 Rust MCP tools (`ELF`, `PE`, `Mach-O`, `APK/DEX`, `.NET`, `WASM`) plus on-demand native Bionic ARM64 `Ghidra 12.1.4` (`decompile` & `sleigh` + `OpenJDK 21`).
  5. **Smart `Built for Android` OTA Plugin Marketplace**: Live OTA catalog (`AGY Video Studio` GPU `h264_mediacodec`, `Craft Anything + Ghidra`, `Game Studio 2D/3D` in Rust for Godot 4 Vulkan, `GitHub Local ARM64 MCP` with 91 tools, `Chrome DevTools` headless ARM64 Chromium, `Android CLI`, and `Science`).

## Other Open-Source Repositories by Yhoanes
- **AI Engineering Harness**: https://github.com/Yhoanes/ai-engineering-harness — Deterministic governance, JSON-Schema Task Contracts, RBAC authority matrices, secret scanning, and context packing framework for AI coding agents (`Python 3.11+`, 684 automated tests).
- **Ferretería 7 Hermanos ERP**: https://github.com/Yhoanes/ferreteria-7-hermanos — Enterprise hardware store ERP, multi-warehouse inventory ledger, and POS system (`Django 6.0`, `PostgreSQL`, `ReportLab`, `OpenPyXL`).
- **Albion Online Flip Finder**: https://github.com/Yhoanes/albion-flip-finder — Real-time NATS stream market arbitrage scanner and profit calculator for Android (`Kotlin 2.0`, `MVVM`, `Coroutines`).
